headline: Harvard shelter order lifted after police detain knife suspect near Weeks Footbridge
dek: Harvard and Cambridge police tracked a man from South Street toward the university’s athletic facilities before taking him into custody Wednesday afternoon; officials have not released details about what led to the encounter.
body: A shelter-in-place order affecting part of Harvard University’s Cambridge campus ended Wednesday after Harvard University police detained a man they said had brandished a knife and fled on a bicycle. The man was taken into custody near the John W. Weeks Memorial Bridge at about 12:23 p.m., according to [Harvard’s emergency alert](https://www.harvard.edu/emergency/).

The incident began with an 11:41 a.m. alert reporting a person with a knife on South Street heading toward John F. Kennedy Street. Harvard told people near the location to shelter in place and asked others to avoid the area. That first message did not identify the person or describe an injury, and the university has not publicly explained what prompted the report.

Five minutes later, Harvard said its police department and Cambridge police were searching around JFK Street and John F. Kennedy Memorial Park for a man who had allegedly brandished a knife and left on a bicycle. The wording describes a police allegation, not a finding of guilt. The search area shifted to Brattle Street by 11:58 a.m., while the shelter instruction remained in effect for people nearby.

The pursuit then moved through a series of familiar public spaces along the Charles River and Harvard Square. Harvard’s 12:17 p.m. update said officers approached the suspect in Cambridge Common, but he ran toward Harvard Square. Police followed as he crossed the John F. Kennedy Bridge in the direction of Harvard’s athletics facilities, according to the university’s alert timeline.

Harvard said officers detained the suspect near the Weeks Footbridge at approximately 12:23 p.m. and lifted the shelter-in-place order after he was in custody. [Boston 25 News](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/harvard-university-incident-suspect-custody-shelter-in-place-lifted/2IIXZ2X5XNBFVGO46FIRY2VPQA/) reported that the order followed a search that began near South Street and expanded through JFK Park and Brattle Street. [WHDH](https://whdh.com/news/harvard-shelter-in-place-lifted-as-police-detain-man-with-knife-following-search/) also reported the detention near the footbridge and said the order was lifted afterward.

The short-lived order nevertheless affected the daily movement of people in one of the region’s busiest university and commercial areas. [The Harvard Crimson](https://www.thecrimson.com/article/2026/10/14/hupd-jfk-park-knife-shelter-in-place/) reported that affiliates inside the Harvard Kennedy School, which is next to the search area, were barred from leaving after the alert. People outside the immediate area were told to stay away while police searched, creating a temporary disruption around Harvard Square and the river crossings.

As of Wednesday afternoon, Harvard had not released the suspect’s name, said whether an arrest had been made, identified possible charges or provided additional details about the alleged knife display. The public alert also did not say whether anyone was hurt. Those gaps matter because a detention is not the same as a criminal conviction, and the available public accounts do not establish what happened before the first alert.

The episode comes weeks after a separate Harvard shelter-in-place order during a search for a man accused of brandishing a knife inside a Peet’s Coffee, a prior incident noted by [The Crimson](https://www.thecrimson.com/article/2026/9/1/hupd-machete-shelter-in-place/). The two events should not be treated as connected. For Wednesday’s case, the confirmed sequence is an alert, a police pursuit across Cambridge, a detention and the lifting of the order; the underlying encounter and any next court action remained unresolved in the latest official information.
location: Harvard Square, JFK Park and the Weeks Footbridge, Cambridge, Massachusetts
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Harvard shelter order lifted after knife suspect detained in Cambridge
seoDescription: Harvard says police detained a man near the Weeks Footbridge after a knife report prompted a temporary shelter-in-place order around campus.
